adaptive_search_disclosure: This is a deliberately adaptive meta-search over already measured 2018-2024 research ledgers. It can identify a useful combination diagnostic but cannot create pristine OOS evidence or a production PASS.
objective: Test whether independently generated broad-PIT, factor, event, pair, and SEC sleeve return streams combine into a more stable static-weight portfolio.
source_exclusions: Every filename containing OOS, INVALID, or POLYGON62
Composite portfolios and post-result risk-layer, hedge, leverage, circuit-breaker, allocator, and ensemble scans
Files without a daily PnL/equity return stream
Cost-stress variants ending in _cost8; cost4 is the comparable SEC base path
Any scenario with less than 95% development calendar coverage
daily_return_contract: For each scenario use daily_pnl divided by prior equity (equity minus daily_pnl). Existing source transaction costs, borrow, financing, and causal compounding remain embedded. Missing dates are zero only after the 95% coverage gate.

family_representative_selection.rank: Higher development Sharpe, then CAGR, then less severe DD, then scenario name
family_representative_selection.cross_family_dedup: In rank order, drop a representative with absolute development correlation >=0.97 to an already retained representative

grid.leverage: None beyond leverage already embedded in each source return stream
grid.rebalance: Static weights applied to daily net return streams; no turnover netting benefit is credited

combination_selection.rank: Higher development Sharpe, then CAGR, then less severe DD, then canonical weight string

audit_requirements: Persist every source scenario metric and rejection reason, retained representatives, development correlation matrix, every grid row, selected daily path, yearly results, source attribution, and manifest with hashes.
Report rule-selection effect separately from static trade-stream combination effect.
Report dollar and percentage DD, source weights, effective sleeve count, source PnL shares, and the absence of a shared ticker-level refill replay.
Even a validation pass is CONTINUE_DIAGNOSTIC only because all source research and 2023-2024 have been touched.
